text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I was hurrying across the 
courtyard because I was about to be late 
for a meeting—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"...Now's the time!! It's Windy-chan from 
undergroundーー!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"How's that! That was so surprising it 
knocked you right off your feet, didn't 
it—"
choice_data_list:
Sorry! I've got a meeting right now, so 
later, okay...!

Sorry! I have a meeting right now, so 
later, okay...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey! What's the big idea?! Your reaction 
is way too weak!!
Oh? What's up, Windy-san?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: !? Y-You're—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The meeting was over and the rush had 
settled down, so I returned to the 
Trainer's room.
choice_data_list: Now then, maybe take a short break...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Help me! Trainer-san!! This is an 
emergency, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's an emergency, yes, it iiis! 
Trainer-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When I bumped into Taiki, we swapped 
bodies--!!
choice_data_list: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy?
text_block_list.text:
Yea—wait, it's not a prank, nanoda! Please 
believe me, nanoda!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! Very yeees! This is a super serious 
matter, you see!!
choice_data_list: We need to get to the hospital, fast...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text: Huh!? You can't do that!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's not it desu!! N-No! That is 
totally not necessary, yo!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy?
text_block_list.text:
That's right, dea—...! ...I'm already 
looking into a way to turn back! And I 
need your help with it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I wasn't quite sure, but I was worried 
about leaving things as they were, so I 
decided to comply."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
All we have to do is whatever we did when 
we swapped in the first place, yes!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy?
text_block_list.text:
I crashed into someone while running in 
the hallway, so I'm gonna try doing the 
exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please walk between us as the 
bystander who was there at the time!
choice_data_list: That's scary?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
Nishishi! No problem! I'll run without 
bumping into anyone as much as I caaan!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
Umm, they sure aren't coming back soon, 
yes-na-no-da!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy?
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Next, let's eat each other's 
favorite foods! Maybe that'll turn us 
back!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
*slurp*! Nice idea! I'd love for you to 
buy me some jerky, YES~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
"I heard there are sweets in the 
Chairwoman's office that can cure 
anything! Right away—"
choice_data_list: Hey, even so, you really can't do this!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Heeey! Who goes there? You can't just 
barge in here without permission!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, the cycle of causing 
trouble left and right and apologizing 
repeatedly continued, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it won't go back at aaall, no-deesu. 
Trainer-san, are you in trooouble~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A subtly off-putting tone of voice... This 
is probably her "usual" self. Which means—
choice_data_list: I'm in a huge bind! What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text: I see, I see... Heheh. Heheheheh!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ah-hah-ha-ha-ha-ha!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The prank was a huge success--!! She fell 
for it hook, line, and sinker!!
choice_data_list:
(I had a feeling this would happen, 
though--!!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Please don't be mad at her! There is a 
deep reason for this—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I seeee! So zat is why she was feeling so 
down!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Because, because, it is terribly 
boring...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The surprised look on her face is 
hilarious! That's why I keep pulling 
pranks on her~~

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I understand! It's so, so lonely when 
there's no reaction! That's why—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Let's set up a prank together that'll 
absolutely blow their minds, babeeey!!"
choice_data_list: (So that's what it was all about...)
(So that's what it was all about...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I got to see a great reaction out of you, 
so I'll let you off for now! But—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"That's what happens when you treat 
Windy-chan's pranks so carelessly!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Be careful from now on, alright?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Part of me wishes she'd be a bit more 
straightforward, but I suppose that's just 
who she is. I'll accept it wholeheartedly.
choice_data_list: Come at me anytime!
Come by anytime!
I gotta work on my reaction speed.
I need to work on my reaction speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Part of me wishes she'd be a bit more 
straightforward, but I suppose that's just 
who she is. I'll accept it wholeheartedly.
choice_data_list: Come at me anytime!
Come by anytime!
I gotta work on my reaction speed.
I need to work on my reaction speed.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now you've said it! Windy-chan's gonna 
keep pranking you without a break, got 
it?!
choice_data_list: I'm confident in my stamina.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Ununu, Windy-chan has way, way, waaaay 
more confidence than that!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You two get along so well together, 
don't you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall play a prank on them even 
sooner!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! But... Won't that fail to get a 
reaction?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh!? You can't do that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"You're doing plenty fine as you are! So 
just stay there and let me prank you!! 
Okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems I'll need to remain constantly 
vigilant against Shinko Windy's pranks 
from now on.
